note: A regular convolutional decoder: 8-bit key -> embedding -> 128 -> 4x4x16, then nearest-neighbour 2x upsampling with 3x3 conv/ReLU at 8x8 and 16x16 and a 3x3 sigmoid head at 32x32. 46929 weights, trained on the same 200 Quick Draw cats as the circuit tabs. Its output is continuous, so it can draw soft edges; the circuit tabs can only return 0/1.
